name: Sidebar
purpose: Provide a finished application-shell side region with expanded, rail, and offcanvas visual states built on Atom Sidebar.
useWhen: An application shell has persistent navigation or tools that collapse to a rail or leave the layout offcanvas.

avoidWhen.condition: The side panel is a temporary modal mobile menu or a static content aside.
avoidWhen.useInstead: Drawer or a semantic page region

composition: Compose Root with Trigger, Panel, and Main; place NavList and other Brick content inside Panel and keep one page-level main landmark.

rules.statement: Use Sidebar state and public layout hooks instead of manually translating a generic aside and overlapping its active items.
Avoid duplicate main landmarks when composing Sidebar.Main into an existing shell.
Load styles.css or core.css plus sidebar.css and every composed child stylesheet.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using Sidebar as a modal drawer or letting highlighted rail items overflow into Main.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Drawer for modal use and validate Sidebar's expanded, rail, and offcanvas geometry.

validation: Check every state, both sides, current navigation item, long labels, icons, counts, trigger, focus, inert offcanvas state, zoom, narrow widths, and RTL.
Confirm landmark names and CSS delivery.
